title: High-Voltage Distribution
subtitle: Move EP farther with clearer bottlenecks
summary: High Voltage Cable and Factory Substations make starter factories easier to diagnose.
body: High Voltage Cable carries 1200 EP/t, making it the preferred line between generators, battery rooms, and machine halls. Factory Substations cap routing at 3000 EP/t and are meant to sit at clear network boundaries so players can see where a factory section starts and ends.
